description: Resend MCP server - send email and manage domains, contacts, broadcasts and API keys through the Resend API (stdio and HTTP transports)
pre_install: # npm install scripts call a bare 'node'; this bucket keeps Node.js off PATH, so put it there for this process only

# npm's peer resolver crashes with "Cannot read properties of null (reading 'edgesOut')" on this package's devDependency peer graph - on registry.npmjs.org as well as on a mirror. --omit=dev does not skip resolving them, so drop them first
if ($deleteCode -ne 0) { throw "npm pkg delete devDependencies failed (exit $deleteCode)" }

# the package's own 'prepare' script runs tsc, a devDependency --omit=dev skipped, so a nonzero exit is expected - the published tarball already ships dist/, what matters is that the dependencies landed
